name: competition-proof
purpose: Participant-facing proof-size package for the synthetic-funnel competition (issue #33). The real competition uses production_reference below; this proof dataset is small enough to distribute and regenerate locally.

production_reference.note: COMPETITION.md §3.1 defaults. Evaluation offsets [730, 760); H = 3 calendar months. Estimated ~7.5M events at 50/50 arrivals, so the production dataset is generated by the organisers later, not as part of this proof kit.

competition.max_training_rows_note: Participant constraint from COMPETITION.md §3.3 (allowed 50000-500000). Not binding on the proof dataset, but recorded in every run config.
competition.evaluation_note: Proof evaluation days. Production evaluation is offsets [730, 760) (30 days). D_eval_end + H <= observation_end_exclusive holds here: 402 + ~90 < 730.

baseline.source: warmup-trained logistic models (model_apply_score / model_screen_score / model_decision_score) refitted from observed warmup referrals and applied to evaluation-day candidates
baseline.derivation_note: COMPETITION.md §7 writes the ordering as p_decision_baseline x fee_if_decided_yen. model_*_score are CONDITIONAL stage scores (apply, screen|apply, decision|screen), so the only marginal decision probability available from the warmup models is their product; using model_decision_score alone would ignore application and screening. This is the interpretation used by this kit.
baseline.order: p_decision_baseline * fee_if_decided_yen descending; ties by (day_dt, user_id, item_id) ascending
